_comment: This is the master list for the whole product catalog. To ADD a product: create a new folder in media/products/ with an image + data.json (copy an existing folder as a template), then add its folder name to the right list below. To REMOVE a product: delete its folder name from the list below (the folder itself can stay or be deleted). To REORDER: change the order of names in the list. Folder names here must exactly match the folder names inside media/products/.
